name: EraSOR
model_likelihood: Two-GWAS same-phenotype per-SNP linear regression Y_k = alpha_kg + beta_kg X_kg + epsilon_kg.
inference_algorithm: Estimate heritabilities, genetic covariance and univariate/bivariate LD score intercepts; infer overlap-induced correlation; apply C^(-1/2) to GWAS z-statistics.
estimand: Decorrelated base GWAS z-statistics for downstream PRS analyses.
data_input: Base and target GWAS summary statistics with SNPs common to both studies and sample sizes; LD score regression quantities.
